risk_summary: The disclosure provides substantial quantitative detail on seasonality, market funding, workforce reduction, tax assets, and contract pricing, but presents a mixed operating outlook with persistent education underfunding and demand uncertainty. Significant risks include extreme seasonal concentration, commodity-cost exposure, limited pricing flexibility, and reliance on bond-funded projects. Management emphasizes operational capabilities and recent improvement, though some forward-looking claims remain qualified and insufficiently quantified.
